text: City Council on January 29, 2020, referred Administrative Inquiry IA14.1 from Councillor Paul Ainslie, Ward 24, Scarborough-Guildwood regarding Delays in Traffic Construction Projects throughout Scarborough-Guildwood and Answer 14.1a from the General Manager, Transportation Services, to the Infrastructure and Environment Committee for consideration.
The Infrastructure and Environment Committee: 1. Received the item for information.
